name: M23
description: the Mathieu group $M_{23}$ in its natural action on $23$ points
identification: $M_{23}$ is the only transitive group of degree $23$ of that order.

known_polynomials.source: of Huang et al. (reported by Epoch AI)

notes.realizable: Epoch AI reports that Huang et al. found a degree-23 polynomial over $\mathbb{Q}$ with Galois group $M_{23}$ whose coefficients have fewer than $100$ digits.
notes.regular: It is not known whether $M_{23}$ is a regular Galois group over $\mathbb{Q}(t)$.

references.title: Epoch AI, FrontierMath Open Problems: Inverse Galois problem for M23
